svg.title: FazerOps architecture
svg.desc: An alert starts a read-only investigation in one Strands Graph: an orchestrator agent, four deterministic collectors in one concurrent batch, a change ledger, Python scoring and a correlator agent produce a Brief. Only the Brief crosses the layer seam into automation, where a proposer agent selects a catalog action, a dry run and inverse are computed, a human approves on a Slack card, and a scoped executor runs it. Catalog growth mines gaps from production evidence.

svg.text: Tier 0 investigates on its own and changes nothing. Every mutation waits for a human approval.
